aulas.objetivo: Cumprimentar, dizer o nome, a idade e de onde você é.
aulas.foco: Greetings; verb to be; My name is...; numbers 1–20
explicacao: Para se apresentar: Hello! My name is Ana. I'm ten. I'm from Brazil.
I'm = I am. Para perguntar: What's your name? How old are you? Where are you from?
Idade usa to be: I'm eleven (nunca 'I have eleven').
Despedidas: Goodbye! See you! Bye!

material.tarefa: Introduce yourself to the examiner. Say your name, how old you are and where you are from. Then say the name of a friend.
material.modelo: Hello! My name is Ana. I'm eleven years old. I'm from Brazil. My friend's name is Lucas. He's eleven too.

exercicios.q: The examiner says: 'Hello! What's your name?' What is the best answer?
exercicios.exp: A pergunta é sobre o nome. A resposta certa é My name is Ana.

exercicios.q: My name ___ Pedro.
exercicios.exp: My name is... é a forma de dizer o nome.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: Hello! My name is Ana.
exercicios.exp: Em name, o som é /neim/. Ana tem A aberto: Â-na.

exercicios.q: 'How old are you?' Which answer is correct?
exercicios.exp: Idade usa to be: I am ten (I'm ten).
Sujeito (I) + verbo (am) + origem (from Brazil).

exercicios.q: Responda: diga sua idade em inglês.
exercicios.frase: How old are you?
exercicios.modelo: I'm eleven years old.
exercicios.exp: Use I'm + número. Pode dizer só: I'm eleven.

exercicios.q: Where ___ you from?
exercicios.exp: Com you usamos are: Where are you from?

exercicios.q: The examiner says: 'Nice to meet you.' What do you say?
exercicios.exp: A resposta natural é Nice to meet you, too (igualmente).

exercicios.q: Responda: diga de onde você é.
exercicios.frase: Where are you from?
exercicios.modelo: I'm from Brazil. I live in Recife.
exercicios.exp: Use I'm from + lugar. Exemplo: I'm from Brazil.

aulas.objetivo: Falar sobre a família: quem são e como se chamam.
aulas.foco: have got; possessive 's; my/his/her; family words
explicacao: I've got a brother. She's got two sisters. (have got = ter)
Possessivo com 's: my mum's name = o nome da minha mãe.
my = meu/minha, his = dele, her = dela.
Pergunta: Have you got any brothers or sisters? Resposta: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

material.tarefa: Talk about your family. Say who is in your family. Say their names and how old they are.
material.modelo: I've got a big family. I live with my mum, my dad and my sister. My sister's name is Bia. She's eight. I've got a grandma too. Her name is Rosa.

exercicios.q: 'Have you got a brother?' What is a good answer?
op: Yes, I have. His name is Leo.
exercicios.exp: A pergunta é com have got. Resposta: Yes, I have.

exercicios.q: I've got a sister. ___ name is Bia.
exercicios.exp: Sister é menina, então usamos her (dela).

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: I've got a brother and a sister.
exercicios.exp: Em I've, junte: /aiv/. Brother tem o th suave: BRÂ-dêr.

exercicios.q: Look at the picture: a woman and a girl. The girl says: 'This is my ___.'
exercicios.exp: A mulher é a mãe: mum.
Possessivo (My) + substantivo (dad) + is + adjetivo.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga se você tem irmãos.
exercicios.frase: Have you got any brothers or sisters?
exercicios.modelo: Yes, I have. I've got one sister. Her name is Bia.
exercicios.exp: Comece com Yes, I have ou No, I haven't e acrescente um detalhe.

exercicios.q: He ___ got two sisters.
exercicios.exp: Com he/she/it usamos has got (he's got).

exercicios.q: 'Who is this?' (a picture of an old man) Choose the best answer.
exercicios.exp: É um homem, então he. Grandpa = vovô.

exercicios.q: Responda: fale sobre a sua família.
exercicios.frase: Tell me about your family.
exercicios.modelo: I live with my mum and my dad. I've got a brother. His name is Leo.
exercicios.exp: Diga quem mora com você e os nomes. Ex.: I live with my mum...

aulas.objetivo: Falar sobre a escola, as matérias e os objetos da sala.
aulas.foco: This is / These are; school subjects; I like...; prepositions in/on
explicacao: Objetos: This is my book. These are my pencils (plural).
Matérias: maths, English, science, art, PE (educação física).
Where is...? It's in my bag. It's on the table.
Em inglês britânico dizemos maths, e a professora é Miss/Mrs/Mr + sobrenome.

material.tarefa: Talk about your school. Say what your favourite lesson is. Say what is in your school bag.
material.modelo: My favourite lesson is English. My teacher is Mrs Lima. In my bag I've got two books, a pencil and a rubber. I like my school.

exercicios.q: The examiner asks: 'What's your favourite lesson?' Best answer:
exercicios.exp: Pergunta sobre matéria preferida: My favourite lesson is art.

exercicios.q: This is my book. ___ are my pencils.
exercicios.exp: Plural (pencils) usa these. Singular usa this.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: My favourite lesson is English.
exercicios.exp: Lesson: LÉ-sôn. English começa com som de ín: ÍN-glish.

exercicios.q: Where is the pencil? (the pencil is inside the bag)
exercicios.exp: Dentro de = in.
Pedido simples: verbo + your + books + please.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que tem na sua mochila.
exercicios.frase: What is in your school bag?
exercicios.modelo: In my bag I've got two books and a pencil.
exercicios.exp: Use I've got + objetos: I've got a book and a pencil.

exercicios.q: Where is my pen? It's ___ the desk.
exercicios.exp: Em cima de uma superfície = on.

exercicios.q: A boy says: 'I like maths. It's easy.' What does he think?
exercicios.exp: Easy = fácil.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga se você gosta da escola e por quê.
exercicios.frase: Do you like school? Why?
exercicios.modelo: Yes, I do. I like my friends and I like English.
exercicios.exp: Use Yes, I do. / No, I don't. + I like... Exemplo: I like my friends.

aulas.objetivo: Descrever a rotina diária com horas e ações.
aulas.foco: Present simple (I/we/you; he/she + s); times; daily routine
explicacao: Rotina: I get up at seven. I have breakfast. I go to school.
Com he/she acrescentamos s: He gets up. She goes to school. She has lunch.
Horas: at seven o'clock, at half past eight (8h30), at quarter past two.
Palavras úteis: first, then, after school, in the evening.

material.tarefa: Tell the examiner about your day. Say what time you get up and what you do after school.
material.modelo: I get up at half past six. I have breakfast and then I go to school. After school I do my homework. I go to bed at nine o'clock.

exercicios.q: 'What time do you get up?' Choose the best answer.
op: I get up in the bed.
I get up at seven o'clock.
exercicios.exp: Pergunta sobre horas: at + hora.

exercicios.q: I ___ breakfast at seven.
exercicios.exp: Dizemos have breakfast (tomar café da manhã). Eat também é aceito.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: I get up at seven o'clock.
exercicios.exp: Get up: guét âp. O'clock: ô-clóc.

exercicios.q: It is 8.30. We say:
exercicios.exp: 8h30 = half past eight.

exercicios.resp: She goes to school by bus
exercicios.exp: He/she + verbo com s: goes. By bus = de ônibus.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga a que horas você acorda.
exercicios.frase: What time do you get up?
exercicios.modelo: I get up at half past six.
exercicios.exp: Use I get up at + hora. Ex.: I get up at seven.

exercicios.q: My brother ___ to bed at nine.
exercicios.exp: Com he usamos goes (go + es).

exercicios.q: 'What do you do after school?' Which answer is NOT good?
exercicios.exp: Get up é de manhã, não depois da escola.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que você faz depois da escola.
exercicios.frase: What do you do after school?
exercicios.modelo: After school I do my homework. Then I play football with my friends.
exercicios.exp: Conecte as ações com then: After school I... Then I...

aulas.objetivo: Falar de comidas e bebidas, pedir e oferecer.
aulas.foco: countable/uncountable; I'd like...; Can I have...?; some/any
explicacao: Pedir: Can I have a sandwich, please? I'd like some water, please.
Oferecer: Would you like an apple? Yes, please. / No, thank you.
Contáveis: an apple, two bananas. Incontáveis: some milk, some rice, some water.
Em perguntas e negativas usamos any: Have you got any juice? We haven't got any bread.

material.tarefa: Talk about food. Say what you eat for breakfast. Say what food and drink you like and what you don't like.
frases_uteis: I like... but I don't like...
material.modelo: For breakfast I have bread and milk. For lunch I eat rice and beans. My favourite food is pizza. I like juice but I don't like tea.

exercicios.q: At a café you are thirsty. What do you say?
exercicios.exp: I'd like ... please é uma forma educada de pedir.

exercicios.q: Can I have ___ apple, please?
exercicios.exp: Apple começa com som de vogal, então usamos an.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: Can I have a sandwich, please?
exercicios.exp: Sandwich: SÉN-uích. Please: plíiz.

exercicios.q: Someone says: 'Would you like some juice?' You want it. Best answer:
exercicios.exp: Aceitar com educação: Yes, please.

exercicios.resp: I would like some milk please
exercicios.exp: Pedido educado: I would like + some + comida/bebida + please.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que você come no café da manhã.
exercicios.frase: What do you have for breakfast?
exercicios.modelo: For breakfast I have bread and milk.
exercicios.exp: Use For breakfast I have + comidas.

exercicios.q: Have you got ___ bread?
exercicios.exp: Em perguntas com incontáveis (bread) usamos any.

exercicios.q: 'Do you like fish?' The picture shows a sad face. Choose:
exercicios.exp: Rosto triste = não gosta: No, I don't.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga sua comida favorita e por quê.
exercicios.frase: What is your favourite food? Why?
exercicios.modelo: My favourite food is pizza. I like it because it's tasty.
exercicios.exp: Use My favourite food is... e I like it because... (porque).

aulas.objetivo: Dizer do que gosta e não gosta e perguntar aos outros.
aulas.foco: like/love/don't like + noun/-ing; Do you like...?; because
explicacao: I like football. I love pizza. I don't like spiders.
Com verbo, usamos -ing: I like swimming. She loves dancing.
Perguntas: Do you like ice cream? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Com he/she: Does he like cats? Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
Because = porque: I like summer because it's hot.

material.tarefa: Talk about the things you like and don't like. Say what animal you like and why. Say what sport you like.
material.modelo: I like dogs because they are friendly. I love swimming. I don't like spiders because they are scary. My favourite sport is football.

exercicios.q: 'Do you like cats?' You don't. Choose the best answer.
exercicios.exp: Resposta curta negativa com I: No, I don't.

exercicios.q: I ___ swimming. It's great!
exercicios.exp: Like e love são aceitos para gostar de algo.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: I love dogs because they are friendly.
exercicios.exp: Because: bi-CÓZ. Friendly: FRÉND-li.

exercicios.q: 'Does your brother like football?' (Yes, he does) The best answer:
exercicios.exp: Com he usamos does na resposta curta.

exercicios.resp: I don't like spiders because they are scary
exercicios.exp: Don't like + substantivo; because + motivo.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga de qual animal você gosta.
exercicios.frase: What animal do you like?
exercicios.modelo: I like dogs. They are friendly.
exercicios.exp: Diga o animal e um motivo: I like dogs because...

exercicios.q: She likes ___ pictures. (draw)
exercicios.exp: Depois de like usamos o verbo com -ing: drawing.

exercicios.q: Choose the sentence with a good reason.
op: I like winter because it's cold and I love snow.
I like winter because I like.
exercicios.exp: Because + frase completa dá o motivo.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que você gosta de fazer no fim de semana e por quê.
exercicios.frase: What do you like doing at the weekend? Why?
exercicios.modelo: I like playing football with my friends because it's fun.
exercicios.exp: Use I like + -ing + because it's fun.

aulas.objetivo: Descrever pessoas: aparência, roupas e idade.
aulas.foco: has got / is; adjectives (tall, short, long hair); clothes; wearing
explicacao: Aparência: She's tall. He's got short brown hair. She's got blue eyes.
Para descrever o que alguém veste: He's wearing a red T-shirt and blue jeans.
A ordem é: opinião, tamanho, cor + substantivo: a small blue bag.
Perguntas: What does he look like? Who is wearing a hat?

material.tarefa: Look at a picture of a girl. She is tall. She has got long brown hair and glasses. She is wearing a yellow T-shirt and blue jeans. Describe her. Then describe a friend.
material.modelo: This girl is tall. She's got long brown hair and glasses. She's wearing a yellow T-shirt and blue jeans. My friend Tom has got short hair and blue eyes.

exercicios.q: Look: a boy with short black hair. What do you say?
exercicios.exp: Usamos have/has got para cabelo e olhos.

exercicios.q: She's got long hair and she ___ glasses.
exercicios.exp: Usamos wears (usa) ou has got para óculos. Wears é o mais natural.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: She's wearing a red dress.
exercicios.exp: Wearing: UÉ-rin. Red: rréd (com r fraco).

exercicios.q: 'Who is the tall man?' The man in the picture has a blue hat.
op: The man in the blue hat.
exercicios.exp: Para identificar: the man in the blue hat.

exercicios.resp: He is wearing a green T-shirt
exercicios.exp: Sujeito + is wearing + roupa.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que um amigo está vestindo.
exercicios.frase: What is your friend wearing today?
exercicios.modelo: He is wearing a blue T-shirt and black trousers.
exercicios.exp: Use He/She is wearing + roupas.

exercicios.q: My grandpa ___ got grey hair.
exercicios.exp: Com he/she/it usamos has got.

exercicios.q: Which description is best for the picture: a short girl, curly red hair, a yellow dress?
op: She's short and she's got curly red hair. She's wearing a yellow dress.
She short and curly hair and wear dress.
She has red hair, tall, jeans.
exercicios.exp: Frase completa e certa, com is e has got.

exercicios.q: Responda: descreva seu melhor amigo ou amiga.
exercicios.frase: What does your best friend look like?
exercicios.modelo: He is tall. He has got short brown hair and green eyes.
exercicios.exp: Fale da altura, do cabelo e dos olhos.

aulas.objetivo: Descrever um quarto e onde ficam as coisas.
aulas.foco: there is / there are; prepositions (in, on, under, next to, behind)
explicacao: There is = há (singular): There is a bed in my room.
There are = há (plural): There are two posters on the wall.
Negativa: There isn't a TV. There aren't any chairs.
Lugares: on (em cima), under (embaixo), next to (ao lado de), behind (atrás de), in front of (na frente de).

material.tarefa: Look at a picture of a bedroom. There is a bed next to the window. There is a cat under the table. There are three books on the desk. Describe the room.
material.modelo: There is a bed next to the window. There is a cat under the table. There are three books on the desk. There is a lamp on the table too.

exercicios.q: Picture: one bed in a room. The best sentence is:
op: There is a bed in the room.
There are a bed in the room.
There is beds in the room.
exercicios.exp: Uma cama: There is a bed.

exercicios.q: There ___ two chairs in my room.
exercicios.exp: Plural (two chairs) pede there are.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: There is a cat under the table.
exercicios.exp: Under: ÂN-dêr. Table: TEI-bol.

exercicios.q: Where is the ball? (the ball is below the bed)
exercicios.exp: Under = embaixo.

exercicios.resp: There are three books on the desk
exercicios.exp: There are + número + substantivo plural + lugar.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que há na sua mesa ou no seu quarto.
exercicios.frase: What is on your desk?
exercicios.modelo: There is a lamp and there are two books on my desk.
exercicios.exp: Use There is (singular) e There are (plural).

exercicios.q: There ___ a TV in my room.
exercicios.exp: Quando não existe uma coisa: There isn't a TV (não há TV).

exercicios.q: Picture: a cat is behind the sofa. What does the examiner expect?
op: The cat is behind the sofa.
The cat is in front of the sofa.
The cat is on the sofa.
The sofa is behind the cat.
exercicios.exp: Behind = atrás de.

exercicios.q: Responda: descreva seu quarto.
exercicios.frase: What is in your bedroom?
exercicios.modelo: There is a bed, a desk and a big window. There are many posters on the wall.
exercicios.exp: Misture there is e there are. Cite pelo menos três coisas.

aulas.objetivo: Falar de lugares da cidade e como chegar.
aulas.foco: places in town; prepositions of place; go straight, turn left/right; is there a...?
explicacao: Lugares: library, park, supermarket, cinema, hospital, bus station.
Perguntar: Where's the post office? Is there a park near here?
Direções: Go straight on. Turn left. Turn right. It's on the corner.
Descrever lugares: next to, opposite (em frente a), between (entre).

material.tarefa: Look at a picture of a town. The park is next to the library. The shop is opposite the cinema. A boy asks: 'Where is the library?' Answer him.
material.modelo: The library is next to the park. Go straight on, then turn left. It's opposite the cinema.

exercicios.q: A tourist asks: 'Where's the park?' Best answer:
exercicios.exp: Where's... pede um lugar: It's next to...

exercicios.q: Not right! Turn ___ at the cinema.
exercicios.exp: Left = esquerda, right = direita.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: Go straight on and turn right.
exercicios.exp: Straight: strêit. Right: rait.

exercicios.q: 'Is there a supermarket near here?' (there is one) Choose:
exercicios.exp: Resposta curta: Yes, there is.

exercicios.resp: The shop is opposite the cinema
exercicios.exp: Lugar + is + opposite + the + outro lugar.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga onde fica sua escola.
exercicios.frase: Where is your school?
exercicios.modelo: My school is next to the park. It's near my house.
exercicios.exp: Use is next to, is near, is opposite.

exercicios.q: The library is ___ the park and the shop.
exercicios.exp: Between = entre dois lugares.

exercicios.q: You want to ask the way to the library. What do you say?
op: Excuse me, where is the library?
exercicios.exp: Para pedir informação: Excuse me, where is...?

exercicios.q: Responda: explique o caminho até o supermercado.
exercicios.frase: Where is the nearest supermarket? Tell the way.
exercicios.modelo: Go straight on and turn left. The supermarket is next to the bank.
exercicios.exp: Use go straight on, turn left/right e next to.

aulas.objetivo: Dizer o que você sabe ou não sabe fazer.
aulas.foco: can / can't; ability; Can you...?; adverbs (well, fast)
explicacao: Can é o verbo da habilidade: I can swim. She can sing.
Não muda com he/she e é sem to: He can run fast.
Negativa: can't (cannot). I can't ride a horse.
Perguntas: Can you swim? Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

material.tarefa: Talk about what you can and can't do. Say two things you can do well and one thing you can't do. Ask me a question with 'Can you...?'.
material.modelo: I can swim and I can ride a bike. I can't play the guitar. Can you swim?

exercicios.q: 'Can you swim?' You can. Choose the best answer.
exercicios.exp: A resposta curta usa can: Yes, I can.

exercicios.q: My sister ___ sing very well.
exercicios.exp: Can + verbo sem to. Sing, sem -s.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: I can ride a bike but I can't swim.
exercicios.exp: Can't: cánt em inglês britânico. Em can, o som é fraco.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
exercicios.exp: Can não muda e depois dele vem o verbo sem to: can dance.
Can + verbo; fast = rápido.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que você sabe fazer bem.
exercicios.frase: What can you do well?
exercicios.modelo: I can draw very well. I can also play football.
exercicios.exp: Use I can + verbo. Acrescente well.

exercicios.q: He can ride a bike but he ___ swim.
exercicios.exp: But indica contraste. Negativa: can't.

exercicios.q: A friend says: 'I can't dance.' What do you say to help?
op: Don't worry. I can teach you.
exercicios.exp: Resposta natural: ajudar. I can teach you (eu posso ensinar).

exercicios.q: Responda: faça uma pergunta com can e diga algo que você sabe fazer.
exercicios.frase: Ask me a question with can. Then tell me what you can do.
exercicios.modelo: Can you swim? I can swim very well and I can ride a bike.
exercicios.exp: Pergunte Can you...? e depois diga I can...

aulas.objetivo: Descrever uma figura: o que as pessoas estão fazendo agora.
aulas.foco: present continuous; describing a picture; at the park/beach; hobbies
explicacao: Para o que acontece agora: am/is/are + verbo-ing. The girl is reading. The boys are playing football.
Ao descrever uma figura: In the picture I can see... / There is a... / He is...
Hobbies: playing football, reading, painting, listening to music, riding a bike.
Perguntas: What is the boy doing? What are they doing?

material.tarefa: Look at a picture of a park. A girl is flying a kite. Two boys are playing football. A man is reading a book under a tree. A dog is running. Describe what is happening.
frases_uteis: In the picture I can see...
material.modelo: In the picture I can see a park. It's sunny. A girl is flying a kite. Two boys are playing football. A man is reading a book under a tree and a dog is running.

exercicios.q: What is the girl doing? (She has a kite.)
exercicios.exp: Ação agora: is + verbo-ing.

exercicios.q: The boys ___ playing football.
exercicios.exp: Boys é plural: are playing.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: Two boys are playing football in the park.
exercicios.exp: Playing: PLÊ-in. Park: parc (o r é fraco em inglês britânico).

exercicios.q: Picture: a man is sitting under a tree and reading. Choose the best description.
op: A man is reading under a tree.
A man reads under a tree.
A man are reading under a tree.
exercicios.exp: Descrever imagem = is + -ing.

exercicios.resp: The dog is running in the park
exercicios.exp: Sujeito + is + verbo-ing + lugar.

exercicios.q: Responda à pergunta sobre a figura: um menino tomando sorvete.
exercicios.frase: What is the boy doing? (He is eating an ice cream.)
exercicios.modelo: He is eating an ice cream.
exercicios.exp: Use He is + verbo-ing: He is eating an ice cream.

exercicios.q: The girl ___ painting a picture.
exercicios.exp: She is painting = ela está pintando.

exercicios.q: The examiner says: 'Tell me about this picture.' What is the best start?
op: In the picture I can see a beach.
exercicios.exp: In the picture I can see... é uma boa abertura.

exercicios.q: Responda: descreva a praia (crianças brincando, sol).
exercicios.frase: Describe the picture: a beach, children, sun.
exercicios.modelo: In the picture I can see a beach. It's sunny. Two children are building a sandcastle.
exercicios.exp: Use I can see... e is/are + -ing.

aulas.objetivo: Contar o que aconteceu ontem e no fim de semana passado.
aulas.foco: past simple (regular -ed; irregular: go-went, have-had, see-saw); yesterday; last weekend
explicacao: Passado de verbos regulares: play – played, watch – watched, visit – visited.
Irregulares comuns: go – went, have – had, see – saw, eat – ate, buy – bought.
Pergunta: What did you do yesterday? Resposta: I played football.
Negativa: I didn't go to school. Depois de didn't, o verbo fica na forma base.

material.tarefa: Tell the examiner about last weekend. Say where you went, what you did and who you were with.
material.modelo: Last weekend I went to my grandma's house. We had lunch together. In the afternoon I played football with my cousin. It was fun.

exercicios.q: 'What did you do yesterday?' Choose the best answer.
op: I watched TV and played football.
exercicios.exp: Ontem = passado simples: watched, played.

exercicios.q: Yesterday I ___ to the cinema. (go)
exercicios.exp: Go é irregular: went.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: Last weekend I visited my grandma.
exercicios.exp: Visited: VI-zi-tid. Last weekend: lást uiquénd.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is correct?
op: I go to the park yesterday.
I did went to the park.
exercicios.exp: Went é o passado de go.

exercicios.resp: We had lunch at my grandma's house
exercicios.exp: Passado: had lunch. Posse com 's.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga o que você fez no domingo passado.
exercicios.frase: What did you do last Sunday?
exercicios.modelo: Last Sunday I visited my cousins. We played football.
exercicios.exp: Use verbos no passado: visited, played, went, had.

exercicios.q: I ___ go to school yesterday. It was Sunday.
exercicios.exp: Negativa do passado: didn't + verbo base.

exercicios.q: A friend asks 'Did you enjoy the film?' You liked it. What do you say?
op: Yes, I did. It was great.
exercicios.exp: Resposta curta no passado: Yes, I did.

exercicios.q: Responda: conte seu fim de semana passado.
exercicios.frase: Where did you go last weekend? What did you do?
exercicios.modelo: I went to the beach with my family. We swam and ate ice cream.
exercicios.exp: Use went, had, saw, played e uma opinião: It was fun.

aulas.objetivo: Achar diferenças entre duas figuras (tarefa da prova).
aulas.foco: Picture A / Picture B; but; in my picture...; colours and numbers
explicacao: Na prova, o examinador descreve a figura A e você corrige a B. Ex.: 'In my picture the cat is black.' Você: 'In my picture it's white.'
Modelo: In my picture..., but in your picture... / No, it's blue. / No, there are three.
Use cores, números, tamanhos, lugares: two dogs / one dog, on the table / under the table.
Fale com frases curtas e claras. Não precisa traduzir tudo.

material.tarefa: Look at two pictures of a kitchen. In Picture A there are two cats and a red cup on the table. In Picture B there is one cat and a blue cup under the table. Tell me three differences.
frases_uteis: There are two...but there is one...
material.modelo: In Picture A there are two cats but in Picture B there is one cat. In Picture A the cup is red but in Picture B it's blue. The cup is on the table in Picture A but under the table in Picture B.

exercicios.q: The examiner says: 'In my picture the boy is wearing a green hat.' In your picture it is red. What do you say?
exercicios.exp: Corrija com: In my picture it's red.

exercicios.q: In my picture there are two dogs, ___ in your picture there is one.
exercicios.exp: But liga uma ideia contrária (mas).

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: In my picture there are three birds.
exercicios.exp: Three: thrí (língua entre os dentes). Birds: bérds.

exercicios.q: Picture A: a red ball. Picture B: a yellow ball. You say:
op: In A it's red but in B it's yellow.
In A is red and B red.
It is not the same, red.
exercicios.exp: Compare: In A... but in B...

exercicios.resp: In my picture the cat is on the sofa
exercicios.exp: Estrutura: In my picture + sujeito + is + lugar.

exercicios.q: Responda: corrija o examinador, a menina come uma banana.
exercicios.frase: In my picture the girl is eating an apple. What about yours? (She is eating a banana.)
exercicios.modelo: In my picture the girl is eating a banana.
exercicios.exp: Repita a frase mudando o detalhe: ... a banana.

exercicios.q: Picture A has a big house. Picture B has a ___ house.
exercicios.exp: Big x small (ou little) são opostos.

exercicios.q: Which is the best correction? Examiner: 'There are four apples on the table.' Picture: three apples.
exercicios.exp: Corrija com No, there are three apples.

exercicios.q: Responda: diga as três diferenças.
exercicios.frase: Tell me three differences between two pictures: A has two cats, B has one; A is sunny, B is rainy; A has a red bag, B has a blue bag.
exercicios.modelo: In A there are two cats but in B there is one. In A it's sunny but in B it's rainy. The bag is red in A but blue in B.
exercicios.exp: Faça três frases: In A... but in B...

aulas.objetivo: Contar uma história curta a partir de figuras.
aulas.foco: story telling; first, then, next, finally; past simple; was/were
explicacao: Na prova você olha 3 ou 4 figuras e conta o que aconteceu. Comece com 'Look at the pictures.' ou 'This is Tom.'
Use palavras de ligação: First..., Then..., Next..., Finally...
Conte no passado (went, saw, took) ou no presente. O importante é ser claro e manter o mesmo tempo.
Termine com um sentimento: He was happy. They were tired. It was a great day.

material.tarefa: Look at four pictures. 1: Tom and his dad are going to the beach. 2: Tom builds a sandcastle. 3: A dog runs and jumps on the sandcastle. 4: Tom is sad but then he laughs. Tell the story.
material.modelo: First Tom and his dad went to the beach. Then Tom built a sandcastle. Next a dog ran and jumped on it. Finally Tom was sad for a minute but then he laughed. It was a great day.

exercicios.q: What is the best way to start telling a story?
op: First, Tom went to the beach.
exercicios.exp: First é a palavra certa para o começo.

exercicios.q: First Tom built a sandcastle. ___ a dog jumped on it. (then, next)
exercicios.exp: A primeira ação já foi dita, então use then ou next.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: First Tom went to the beach with his dad.
exercicios.exp: Beach: bítch. Went: uént.

exercicios.q: Which word goes at the END of the story?
exercicios.exp: Finally = finalmente, para o fim.

exercicios.resp: Then a dog jumped on the sandcastle
exercicios.exp: Then + sujeito + verbo no passado + lugar.

exercicios.q: Responda: conte a primeira figura.
exercicios.frase: Look at picture 1: Tom and his dad are at the beach. Tell me what happened.
exercicios.modelo: First Tom went to the beach with his dad.
exercicios.exp: Comece com First e use o passado: went.

exercicios.q: Tom ___ sad when the dog jumped on his sandcastle.
exercicios.exp: Was é o passado de is para I/he/she/it.

exercicios.q: Choose the best ending for the story.
op: It was a great day. Tom was happy.
And tomorrow I go to school.
exercicios.exp: Fecha a história com um sentimento: It was a great day.

exercicios.q: Responda: conte a história completa com as quatro figuras.
exercicios.frase: Tell the whole story: boy goes to the beach, builds a sandcastle, dog jumps on it, boy laughs.
exercicios.modelo: First Tom went to the beach. Then he built a sandcastle. Next a dog jumped on it. Finally Tom laughed. It was a great day.
exercicios.exp: Use First, Then, Next, Finally e termine com uma frase de sentimento.

aulas.objetivo: Simulado das quatro partes da prova de Speaking (Movers/Flyers).
aulas.foco: Exam practice: find differences; information questions; picture description; story
explicacao: Parte 1: o examinador mostra duas figuras parecidas e você acha diferenças.
Parte 2: perguntas sobre uma figura (What is the boy doing? What colour is the bag?).
Parte 3: perguntas pessoais (name, family, school, weekend).
Parte 4: contar uma história com 4 figuras. Dica: fale devagar e use frases curtas e completas.

material.tarefa: Part 4: Look at four pictures. 1: Anna wakes up and it is sunny. 2: She walks to the park with her dog. 3: The dog runs after a ball. 4: Anna and the dog sit under a tree and Anna is happy. Tell the story.
material.modelo: First Anna woke up and it was sunny. Then she walked to the park with her dog. Next the dog ran after a ball. Finally Anna and the dog sat under a tree. She was happy.

exercicios.q: Part 3. The examiner asks: 'What's your name and how old are you?' Best answer:
exercicios.exp: Respondeu as duas perguntas: nome e idade.

exercicios.q: Part 1. In my picture there ___ three birds.
exercicios.exp: Birds é plural: there are.

exercicios.q: Leia em voz alta esta frase.
exercicios.frase: In my picture the girl is wearing a yellow dress.
exercicios.exp: Wearing: UÉ-rin. Yellow: IÉ-lou.

exercicios.q: Part 1. Examiner: 'In my picture the man is reading.' Your picture: he is eating. You say:
op: In my picture he is eating.
In my pictures man eats no.
exercicios.exp: Corrija a informação com In my picture...

exercicios.resp: There is a dog under the table
exercicios.exp: There is + objeto + lugar.

exercicios.q: Responda: o menino anda de bicicleta.
exercicios.frase: Part 2. What is the boy doing? (He is riding a bike.)
exercicios.modelo: He is riding a bike.
exercicios.exp: Use He is + verbo-ing.

exercicios.q: Part 3. What did you do yesterday? I ___ football. (play)
exercicios.exp: Passado regular: play + ed = played.

exercicios.q: Part 3. 'Do you like school?' Which answer is best?
op: Yes, I do. I like English.
exercicios.exp: Resposta curta e um detalhe extra.

exercicios.q: Responda: fale sobre sua família.
exercicios.frase: Part 3. Tell me about your family.
exercicios.modelo: I live with my mum, my dad and my sister. My sister is eight.
exercicios.exp: Diga quem é e quantos anos têm.

exercicios.q: Part 4. Which is the best last sentence of a story?
op: And then and then and then.
exercicios.exp: Terminar com Finally e um sentimento deixa a história completa.

exercicios.q: Responda: fale do seu fim de semana passado.
exercicios.frase: Part 3. What did you do last weekend?
exercicios.modelo: Last weekend I went to the park and played football.
exercicios.exp: Use verbos no passado: went, played, visited.

exercicios.q: Part 4. At the end Anna ___ happy. (be)
exercicios.exp: Passado de be com she: was.

exercicios.q: Responda: conte a história inteira.
exercicios.frase: Part 4. Tell the story with four pictures (Anna, the park, the dog, the tree).
exercicios.modelo: First Anna woke up. Then she went to the park with her dog. Next the dog ran after a ball. Finally they sat under a tree. She was happy.
exercicios.exp: First, Then, Next, Finally e termine com um sentimento.
